item.title: 【BLU-RAY】BLU-RAY - Taylor Swift: Speak Now World Tour Live [Blu-ray] (2011)
item.description:
Taylor Swift: Speak Now World Tour Live [Blu-ray] (2011)



Quality: Blu-ray | Container: BDMV | Video codec: MPEG4 | Audio Codec: AC3, PCM
Country, Pop | Duration: 02:09:26 | 18.6 GB

Video: 1920x1080p, MPEG-4 AVC, 23,976 fps, ~ 15969 kbps
Audio No. 1: Dolby Digital Audio 5.1 (48 KHZ / 448 KBPS)
Audio No. 2: LPCM 2.0 (48 KHZ / 1536 KBPS / 16-bit)

Taylor's all-new CD+Blu-ray featuring the Speak Now tour Live on both CD and Blu-ray. "Speak Now World Tour - Live" is Big Machine's first release of live music from Taylor. The Blu-ray will give fans the complete Taylor Swift Speak Now concert experience, showcasing performances of all 17 songs from Taylor's Speak Now show (Sparks Fly, Mine, Story of Us, Our Song,Mean,Back To December, Better Than Revenge, Speak Now, Fearless, Last Kiss, You Belong With Me, Dear John, Enchanted, Haunted, Long Live, Fifteen, and Love Story), plus additional bonus content. The CD will contain over 75 minutes of music, including live versions of favorites from the Speak Now album.
